# Connecting CompanyCam to Salesforce

Learn how to prepare your Salesforce org, install the CompanyCam package, connect your account, and add CompanyCam to your Account or custom object records.

![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2651343938/475a50954c8546f9b8f88e51684c/download.png?expires=1794184200&signature=381657b3194c1f1afe44880d72052d659c562c7352a9a615ed095b3413ee0263&req=diYiF8p6nohcUfMW1HO4zXHx9kV5DNLJsV%2FvJUY02toor%2BrwtEK4P%2BGq2Y3b%0A40O7TM1zmTBg5Sxb9Us%3D%0A)

Salesforce is a customer relationship management (CRM) platform used to track leads, opportunities, and customer records. Connecting CompanyCam to Salesforce installs a package that brings your Project photos and files onto your Salesforce records, so your sales and ops teams can see job site documentation without leaving Salesforce.

​

This article covers preparing your Salesforce org, installing the package, connecting your CompanyCam account, and adding CompanyCam to your records.

This integration is only available on the web app.

* * *

## How the integration works

Once you're connected, each Salesforce record you set up gets a matching Project in CompanyCam. That can be an Account or a custom object like a Job.

Here's what moves in each direction:

- **Salesforce to CompanyCam:** the record's name and address create the Project and fill in its details.

- **CompanyCam to Salesforce:** photos and files from that Project show up on the record, so your office can see the job without switching platforms.


A Project is created when someone opens a record with **Auto Create Project** turned on, or when someone clicks **Create as Project in CompanyCam** on the record.

![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2768213829/bd6e8b1b7ad35c1fb39f3825f225/Lilian-s-2BWeb-2BMockups.png?expires=1794184200&signature=3aa40a5b106c62f01e882af300fd7cfb7f82ddc6bf42a285d88c8e7a35a5eb12&req=dichHst%2FnoldUPMW1HO4zfstT1%2F2WnjDrZ35Sg%2BuhIDQTjx88f2RV7Wf3VIb%0ANoY1%2F46FqheI62FdjGc%3D%0A)

**Note:** Documents, Checklists, and Reports aren't available in the photo viewer yet. Files from the Project still reach Salesforce as a clickable PDF link.

* * *

## Preparing your Salesforce org

**Note:** You need Admin or Manager permissions in CompanyCam and System Administrator access in Salesforce to set up this integration. See [Permission Roles Explained](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/14010242-permission-roles-explained).

The CompanyCam package needs the Orders object turned on and at least one Order Record Type before it installs.

1. In Salesforce, click the gear icon in the top-right, then click **Setup**.

2. In the **Quick Find** box, search for **Order Settings**.

3. Check **Enable Orders**, then click **Save**.









![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2771161447/22791140e0c242de898ae9bdf65c/2.png?expires=1794184200&signature=7ec4808bd13b05ecd2df7576583706510bdc66abede771c5d88d3f2fd3a59af9&req=dicgF8h4nIVbXvMW1HO4zW3U77OaTPRWrVPBMo5HEsuhJbp3VtwWV7i7EIaX%0A0wPf%0A)

4. Click the **Object Manager** tab, search for **Order**, then click it.

5. Click **Record Types** in the left-hand menu, then click **New**.

6. Leave **Existing Record Type** set to **Master**, then enter a **Record Type Label**, like Roof Replacement. The **Record Type Name** fills in automatically.

7. Leave **Active** checked, then click **Next**.

8. Choose **Apply one layout to all profiles**, then click **Save**.









![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2771161950/a4e313323cdd2a01101ac57e3219/3.png?expires=1794184200&signature=09ca446aaac39bc3f6fcfb846d80f3efccfe785c9fc281e7a60fd772d8a49a69&req=dicgF8h4nIhaWfMW1HO4zdzIyUrZW0sqyTmiIcqp7SZTqmlH8dAGT8Mc205I%0AMXBl%0A)


* * *

## Installing the CompanyCam package

1. While logged in to Salesforce, open the [Package Install Link](https://login.salesforce.com/packaging/installPackage.apexp?p0=04tKg0000000S9L).

2. Select **Install for All Users**.

3. Check the box to acknowledge you're installing a non-Salesforce application, then click **Install**.









![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2771162223/18ee9faa2cfff19744caa51db0ea/4.png?expires=1794184200&signature=560c95226f5008cde06460469097993a0df2342690cbfc39f17150613f479520&req=dicgF8h4n4NdWvMW1HO4zYq8ByZvv1AJ1g%2FKQ4fxM7n%2FtnLG1gseY544j%2FYB%0A5JoB%0A)

4. If you're asked to approve third-party access, check **Yes, grant access to these third-party web sites**, then click **Continue**.

5. When you see **Installation Complete**, click **Done**.









![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2771162586/a6382bb8ed043c43e464e0112ca3/5.png?expires=1794184200&signature=28bd0a18d3e66e4eb53f3c906adee5390475750f22e84320c15340ce20064189&req=dicgF8h4n4RXX%2FMW1HO4zfhoJFWI1yTlyNlBQzMPXQ5hBXvAb3PnQCszs7HD%0AKsoH%0A)


**Note:** To install into a sandbox instead, append `/packaging/installPackage.apexp?p0=04tKg0000000S9L` to your sandbox domain. Your sandbox connects separately from your production org.

* * *

## Requesting access and adding your credentials

Before your org can connect, our team adds it to our allowlist and sends you a Client ID and Client Secret.

1. In Salesforce **Setup**, search **Auth. Providers** in the **Quick Find** box.

2. Click the **Doorkeeper** auth provider that the package installed.

3. Copy the **Callback URL** near the bottom of the page.









![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2771162948/d9519f38298ca971dcda202bce55/6.png?expires=1794184200&signature=58b989bf9808ddb3542088097f2a57a85cacc01aa8bc756cac4c1e7929348ba7&req=dicgF8h4n4hbUfMW1HO4zXPVCdiHU5zlmHOukaGVlZE1TkpEwbe2cWGNsH68%0AyxSy%0A)

4. Email the **Callback URL** to [support@companycam.com](mailto:support@companycam.com) and let us know you're connecting Salesforce. We'll add your org to our allowlist and reply with your Client ID and Client Secret.

5. Once you have them, go back to the **Doorkeeper** auth provider, then click **Edit**.

6. Paste the Client ID into **Consumer Key** and the Client Secret into **Consumer Secret**, then click **Save**.


**Note:** Setting up a sandbox too? Send us the sandbox's **Callback URL** as well. Each sandbox is added to the allowlist separately.

* * *

## Connecting your CompanyCam account

1. In Salesforce **Setup**, search **Named Credentials** in the **Quick Find** box.

2. Click **CompanyCam**. Its **Authentication Status** shows **Pending**.









![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2771163780/d054b34506ea7bef3310478335ad/7.png?expires=1794184200&signature=22eb97753bbde3f0a4ec1c96e79eb29b6adb0279746287332105354e3cbba1eb&req=dicgF8h4noZXWfMW1HO4zWyJXJxIltSaGMef2pWrvr5oi0%2FFaMlq2kYXVOn%2B%0AiAIh%0A)

3. Click **Edit**, then click **Save** without changing anything.

4. Log in to CompanyCam when prompted, then click **Authorize**.









![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2771191102/92fda097a47fddd24feb23f0054b/2.png?expires=1794184200&signature=7eb24097d15e85dc82346f2007d75aedc2b77b3421378fbc55b8b5f0882d0fc0&req=dicgF8h3nIBfW%2FMW1HO4zU3ws9yicnhlmbYb9N%2F2AOvb1pg3nubes%2FwCoKba%0A2bxh%0A)

5. Back on the Named Credential, confirm the **Authentication Status** now shows **Authenticated**.









![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2771191339/d48cb1c53a7f7e9d5f6c45df1108/3.png?expires=1794184200&signature=c061cbc825c8a6fce7f96f3594442f94b4205431ddd70e9b4b4ceb4796592aed&req=dicgF8h3nIJcUPMW1HO4zYbxNY91McyYbWO9haHRjvgNpk6u9pXOw7GhSm2t%0AYA1K%0A)


**Note:** The integration acts as the CompanyCam User who authorizes it, and Projects are created in that User's company. Use an Admin account that will stay with your company. If you remove that user later, the connection stops working until someone authorizes it again.

## Adding CompanyCam to your records

These steps add CompanyCam to the Account page. Using a custom object instead? Skip to Using a custom object.

**Important:** Drag the component named **CompanyCam** onto the page, not **CompanyCamLightningComponent**. The wrong one leaves a blank section or a broken page icon on every record.

1. Click the **App Launcher**, the grid of dots in the top-left, search for **Accounts**, then open any Account.

2. Click the gear icon in the top-right, then click **Edit Page**.

3. In the **Components** list on the left, scroll to **Custom - Managed** and find **CompanyCam**.









![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2783274476/367a6418c28020346e452f6ac51a/4.png?expires=1794184200&signature=7fac0b0492c3c70da73c471f3375d63a0f57435c0b64f7b69c1022ea38d3f8f1&req=dicvFct5mYVYX%2FMW1HO4zfO4nNeDewRkRnOgMNYVPteDvB8b8P6oiMWhFnzL%0A9%2FH%2F%0A)

4. Drag **CompanyCam** onto the page.

5. Click the component to open its settings on the right, then uncheck **Auto Create Project** for now.









![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2771192088/ee76bdbb4183713eb606ed0e9d13/5.png?expires=1794184200&signature=85e6f845e67eff889346ac497862fdb9b90d31837616f62b990a78cf3f699528&req=dicgF8h3n4FXUfMW1HO4zUjzSpQ2v3e9iUgC1ddwL4c0ah33tU9vJnFo6BDv%0APzI5%0A)

6. Fill in the settings using the table below. **Project Id Field** starts out as **Account Description**, so be sure to change it to **CompanyCam Project ID**.









![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2771192707/60919d9894fd6bcd83ec4740e3b6/6.png?expires=1794184200&signature=ebd7809d9570998d32b3ad30a2a0ecb3319af39bdfc4127a23e4e9f50dff7e14&req=dicgF8h3n4ZfXvMW1HO4zaa21QXFslAVxbjsRnMC3yRpnVsAIYP3PVxwEmvw%0AHz0H%0A)







![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2771193023/0b2dab44a83129b126ffefae0af1/7.png?expires=1794184200&signature=400ed6009af3bc9a5f4e32db968c03153389cd76cbe6c8b4886c89d54af5063d&req=dicgF8h3noFdWvMW1HO4zcg7KZaT8btRKVIp0jZum%2BkonVRfWKi%2FcHewHko6%0ASR2u%0A)

7. Check **Auto Create Project** if you want Projects created automatically, then click **Save**.

8. Click **Activation**, choose **Assign as Org Default**, select **Desktop and phone**, then click **Next**.









![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2771209950/39256f2a68c57c2ed7c535efd6c7/2.png?expires=1794184200&signature=b6baea2ea01a9290f10c9e9339db8bbd11ce04d2c61b7ffba330400343bac336&req=dicgF8t%2BlIhaWfMW1HO4zXMczmCtOuNyhZuwTKKw%2FdGSweGmBMFPoGP%2FjRVw%0AyBe1%0A)

9. Click the back arrow to return to the Account.









![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2771210243/1f2b4e457b12d9e726d335c68f22/3.png?expires=1794184200&signature=8f5c278b64ee12948736372c12b061fcb53c6f7928bbf5a8ca91d758d3da73c0&req=dicgF8t%2FnYNbWvMW1HO4zYKf9lvKdmrnEtr6UgnjXrWnQY7PQpwSLBpjYpbJ%0AMniA%0A)


|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Setting** | **What to choose** |
| Project Id Field | CompanyCam Project ID |
| Project Name Field | Account Name |
| Street 1 Field | Billing Street |
| Street 2 Field | None |
| City Field | Billing City |
| State Field | Billing State/Province |
| Postal Code | Billing Zip/Postal Code |

## Giving your team access

Users won't see CompanyCam on a record until they have the permission set.

1. In Salesforce **Setup**, search **Permission Sets** in the **Quick Find** box.

2. Click **CompanyCam User**, then click **Manage Assignments**.

3. Click **Add Assignment**, check the Users who need CompanyCam, click **Next**, then click **Assign**.

## Using a custom object

CompanyCam can create Projects from a custom object, like a Job, instead of an Account. Work through every section above, up to and including Connecting your CompanyCam account, before you start here.

**Note:** A custom object needs its own CompanyCam Project ID field and separate text fields for the address. The package only adds the Project ID field to Accounts.

## Adding the fields

1. In **Object Manager**, open your custom object, then click **Fields & Relationships**. ( _Only if you're creating a brand new object and it's tab_)









![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2771380835/35a98909b6f916c1d8af3b5650f5/2.png?expires=1794184200&signature=1de88c444d0fff34f9900ef9462d16ec0cd0c7abeefd22daf0cba9bcb5aa27bd&req=dicgF8p2nYlcXPMW1HO4zQ2u%2B%2FHYo1%2Fmni3oBAK4T1RvM9zifUXikoVbiug8%0A7EwN%0A)

2. Click **New**, choose **Text**, then create a field named **CompanyCam Project ID** with a length of 50.

3. Create separate text fields for Street, City, State, and Zip if your object doesn't have them already.









![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2771390909/ee29402e503a6d7c87c699a2d921/3.png?expires=1794184200&signature=9bc9c3ff6dbc0d99eb9985dde090d14e81c2bf9682634c408aae2c8c33f323de&req=dicgF8p3nYhfUPMW1HO4zY5N8%2FNakPutCtQsP1wNYaB3BCCTpAz5HyM99Rbx%0AZQeS%0A)

## Common setup errors

### Authentication fails with a redirect URI error

Your org hasn't been added to our allowlist yet. Send the **Callback URL** from your **Doorkeeper** auth provider to [support@companycam.com](mailto:support@companycam.com), as described in Requesting access and adding your credentials.

​

### The Named Credential still says Pending

Check that the Client ID and Client Secret are saved on the **Doorkeeper** auth provider. Then open the **CompanyCam** Named Credential, click **Edit**, and click **Save** to authorize again.

​

### The CompanyCam section is blank or shows a broken page icon

**CompanyCamLightningComponent** was added instead of **CompanyCam**. Edit the page, remove that component, then add **CompanyCam**.

​

### Installation error related to the Orders object

Enable the Orders object and create a Record Type, as described in Preparing your Salesforce org.

​

### A Visualforce page or link suddenly returns an error

This is usually caused by a Salesforce Hyperforce update affecting page URLs. Update any formula references to your Visualforce pages to this format: `INSERT_YOUR_DOMAIN_HERE.vf.force.com/apex/Companycam_Project_[object]?id=`. Contact Support if that doesn't resolve it.

# FAQs

### Why is a Project only created when someone opens the record?

**Auto Create Project** creates the Project when a record is opened, not when it's saved. To create Projects as soon as a record is saved, your Salesforce admin can set up a record-triggered Flow using the CompanyCam Create Project action.

### Can this be installed in a sandbox?

This package can be installed in a Salesforce sandbox. Append `/packaging/installPackage.apexp?p0=04tKg0000000S9L` to your sandbox domain to install it, then send us the sandbox's **Callback URL** so we can add it to our allowlist.

### Can this integrate with Custom Objects or FSL?

This integration can be installed on any object, including Custom Objects and Field Service Lightning (FSL). See Using a custom object above.

### Can multiple CompanyCam accounts connect to one Salesforce org?

Multiple CompanyCam accounts can connect to a single Salesforce org. This is supported in Lightning using custom metadata records, plus some automation in your org to set the record's value. See [Adding a second (or more) CompanyCam Connection](https://www.loom.com/share/b97ca508406443fc9dca0478772e0866) for setup details.

### How do I set this up in Salesforce Classic?

Salesforce Classic and improveit360 without Lightning follow a different path. Watch the [Classic Setup Video](https://companycam.screencasthost.com/watch/cT1TqZnXPhI). The steps in this article are for Lightning.

### Will Documents, Checklists, and Reports sync to Salesforce?

Files from the Project reach Salesforce as a clickable PDF link. Documents, Checklists, and Reports aren't currently available in the Salesforce photo viewer. We'll share updates here as this changes.

### Why am I seeing duplicate Projects?

Duplicate Projects usually mean the **Project Id Field** isn't mapped to **CompanyCam Project ID**. That field is how Salesforce remembers which Project belongs to the record, so if it's blank or pointing somewhere else, opening the record creates another Project. Edit the page, check the mapping, then clear the duplicates in CompanyCam.
